items.title: XRP falls 10% as long bets unwind and ETF assets slip below $1 billion

items.title: Chainflip confirms $12M hack, offers attacker 10% bounty

items.title: ECB seeks industry partners for tokenized deposits, securities experiments
items.description: Industry groups have until Dec. 11 to apply for the ECB’s first experimental exercises under its Appia initiative, with later submissions reviewed on a rolling basis.

items.title: US lawmakers propose up to 30% rewards for prediction market whistleblowers

items.title: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton warns Americans of 'bumps in the road' after tech outages

items.title: Employees at Eric Trump-backed robot startup lose health benefits as company's cash crunch deepens
